PaiNovel Privacy Policy

Effective date: 2026-10-13 · Language: English

This Policy explains how the current version of PaiNovel handles information. The current build is a local demonstration and does not integrate accounts, advertising, analytics, crash reporting, or real payment services. We will update this Policy and store disclosures before enabling any such capability.

1. Information we handle

By default, library items, reading progress, bookmarks, search terms, coin balance, reading and notification preferences, reviews, and tips are demonstration data held on the device or in the current process. PaiNovel does not upload them to a remote service.

Only when API_BASE_URL is explicitly supplied at build time does the Discover screen request a novel catalog from that server. Network infrastructure may automatically process connection data such as IP address, request time, and User-Agent. The current repository implements no persistent server logs, user accounts, or database.

2. Permissions and device access

The Android release manifest declares no camera, microphone, location, contacts, photos, storage, notification, or advertising identifier permission. iOS declares no corresponding sensitive permission usage descriptions. Debug and profile Android builds declare internet access for development tooling only.

The current mobile app does not read user photos or files. The separate browser-based operations console can select covers, text, Markdown, or ZIP files; the browser parses these locally and may send draft data to its configured operations API. That console is not an end-user mobile feature.

3. Third-party services

The current mobile app uses Flutter, flutter_bloc, equatable, and http. It includes no advertising, behavioral analytics, crash reporting, social sign-in, cloud storage, or payment SDK.

Before adding Google Play Billing, advertising, analytics, crash reporting, or another third party, we will identify the provider, data, purpose, sharing, and provider policy, and update the Google Play Data safety disclosure.

4. Payments and virtual coins

The current recharge screen performs a local action explicitly labeled “Mock purchase.” It does not charge the user and does not integrate Google Play Billing. Chapter unlocks and author tips only modify a demonstration balance.

If a Google Play release later sells virtual coins, subscriptions, or digital content, it will use billing required by the applicable Google Play Payments policy and display pricing and terms. Payment credentials would be handled by the payment platform.

5. Retention and deletion

The current mobile app does not offer account creation and has no PaiNovel-controlled user database. In-memory data disappears when the process ends; bundled content remains until the app is removed or updated. Enabling the current remote API does not add account persistence.

Because there is currently no account or remote user profile, there is no account-deletion flow. Users can clear app data or uninstall to remove device data. Before introducing account creation, we will provide both an in-app deletion path and a public web deletion path and disclose any data and periods that must be retained for law or security.

6. Security and international transfers

We will apply reasonable transport protection and access controls appropriate to an actual deployment. Production server location, logging providers, and international transfers cannot be confirmed from the current code and must be added before those configurations are enabled.

7. Children

The current code has no age gate or child-directed design. Before release, the publisher must complete content-rating and age-audience settings for target markets. The service should not be marketed as child-directed until that assessment is complete.

8. Changes and contact

We may update this Policy for feature, legal, or provider changes and will show a new effective date. Privacy questions may be sent to hovey@vip.qq.com. Operator: DagoodPai.
